description: Phase 7 onwards: deliberate changes to the runtime imported in Phase 2. Each modified imported file records its current SHA-256 and the change that made it; files added after the import are listed with their role (runtime, test, or test-helper: a file tests load but the runner does not run). tools/migration/test/import-manifest.test.js checks both; build/test/run-tests.mjs also runs the tests added here. Imported files deliberately deleted are listed under removed, with the change and the reason. Refresh the hashes with: node tools/migration/bin/runtime-changes.mjs --write
